title: New in Symfony 8.2: Cross-Application Messaging
content:
<html><head></head><body>Messenger transports often connect your Symfony application to other
applications, which may not use Symfony or even PHP. For example, a shop
publishes its orders to RabbitMQ and an invoicing service written in Go consumes
them. Symfony 8.2 adds a new serializer…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
